paras: Gonocephalus mjobergi is a species of lizard in the subfamily Draconinae of the family Agamidae. The species is native to Indonesia and Malaysia.
The specific name, mjobergi is in honor of Swedish zoologist Eric Georg Mjöberg.
The preferred natural habitat of Gonocephalus mjobergi is forest, at elevations of 2,134–2,250 m (7,000–7,380 ft).
Gonocephalus mjobergi is arboreal and diurnal.
